deals.travelWindow: Jan–Feb 2027, Allegiant nonstop; $52 one-way Jan 10/23, $60 Jan 17/24/30, Feb 6
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $52 (Jan 30) and $60 (Jan 17), $69 on several Jan–Feb dates, $79 Dec 13, about $104–140 round trip; still the cheapest verified fare, Everglades 1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and Riverwalk, a water taxi network and cheap beach hostels make it easy alone.

highlights: Everglades airboat or Shark Valley tram day trip
Water Taxi along the Intracoastal
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the A1A promenade
Riverwalk and Las Olas Boulevard on foot
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, ride to the beach, A1A walk and sunset at Las Olas Beach
Day 2 — Everglades day: Anhinga Trail at Royal Palm, then the Shark Valley tram
Day 3 — Water Taxi to Hugh Taylor Birch State Park, then Riverwalk and a last dinner on Las Olas
guide.gettingAround: Airport is 3 miles from downtown; use Brightline/Tri-Rail, the Water Taxi and rideshare. Rent a car only for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Beach area near Las Olas or downtown by the Riverwalk: walkable with hostels and budget hotels.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 14 – Jan 1 and Apr 2027, Allegiant nonstop; $67 one-way Nov 14, $89 Dec 17/Jan 1/Apr 13
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $61 (Dec 13) with $67 Nov 14 and $73 Jan 2, about $122–170 round trip; Great Smoky Mountains NP is an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact Market Square and Old City are walkable and the Urban Wilderness trails are inside the city.

highlights: Smokies day trip: Alum Cave or Laurel Falls
Urban Wilderness trails and Ijams Nature Center
Sunsphere observation deck (free)
Market Square and Old City nights, plus the Sunsphere view
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, Market Square, Sunsphere view, Old City evening
Day 2 — Rental car to Great Smoky Mountains NP: Laurel Falls or Alum Cave Trail
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center or the Urban Wilderness loop, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable, but you need a rental car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square, for walkability and food.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 6 – Nov 25, cheapest Nov 13 out / Nov 16 or 23 back
deals.whyRanked: New on the board: Allegiant one-way $56 (Nov 13) out and $56–63 back (Nov 9/16/23), about $119–160 round trip; no national park nearby, but a compact, easy solo city break.
deals.soloWhy: Small, safe, walkable downtown with a skywalk system and free sculpture park, easy on a low budget.

highlights: Pappajohn Sculpture Park and Western Gateway Park, free and walkable
Iowa State Capitol (free tours, gold dome)
Des Moines Art Center, free admission
East Village shops and the Court Avenue District
Saturday farmers market is closed by November, so use Water Works Park trails instead
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, drop bags downtown, walk the Pappajohn Sculpture Park and Western Gateway, dinner in the East Village.
Day 2 — Capitol tour in the morning, Des Moines Art Center in the afternoon, Court Avenue for the evening.
Day 3 — Easy trail loop through Water Works Park or the Neal Smith Trail, then head to the airport.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable and the skywalk helps in cold weather; use rideshare for the Art Center and the airport, since transit is limited.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the East Village: closest to the sights, restaurants and bars, with no car needed.
food: Raygun (East Village, local gifts and coffee nearby)
A pork tenderloin sandwich at any classic Iowa spot

deals.travelWindow: Nov 5 – Jan 3, Allegiant nonstop; $68 one-way Dec 31, $116 Nov 5/19, Jan 3
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $116 (Nov 15), $128 (Nov 19), $140 on Oct 29/Nov 1/5, about $136–190 round trip; dunes 45 min, Sleeping Bear 2.5 h.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown, a big craft-beer and museum scene, and a safe small city.

highlights: Lake Michigan dunes at Hoffmaster or Grand Haven
Grand Rapids Art Museum
Downtown brewery trail (Founders, Brewery Vivant)
Frederik Meijer Gardens and Sculpture Park
itinerary: Day 1 — Land and settle in; Downtown, art museum, brewery evening
Day 2 — Meijer Gardens, then Grand Haven pier
Day 3 — Hoffmaster dunes boardwalk, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable and the DASH shuttle is free; rent a car for the lakeshore.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Heritage Hill for walkability to breweries and museums.

deals.travelWindow: Dec 7 – Jan 4 and Mar 2027, Allegiant nonstop; $80 one-way Dec 11, $95 Dec 7/17, Jan 4
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $73 (Feb 26, Mar 1), $87 Dec 31, $95 on several dates, about $160–190 round trip; Blue Ridge Parkway 15 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, walkable downtown with a strong hostel and brewery scene plus easy trailheads near town.

highlights: Brewery row on Wedge and Coxe Ave
Biltmore Estate grounds
Blue Ridge Parkway overlooks, including Craggy Gardens
Downtown and the River Arts District on foot
itinerary: Day 1 — Land and settle in; Downtown walk, River Arts District studios, dinner on Biltmore Ave
Day 2 — Rental car up the Parkway: Craggy Gardens Pinnacle
Day 3 — Biltmore grounds or Mount Pisgah views, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable but the Parkway and trailheads need a rental car; check Parkway closures for winter ice.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Montford/South Slope for walkable food and breweries.
